risk_description:
The welding points of the upper front bumper (Softnose) between the cover and the inner lining have an insufficiently robust design.
In the upper front bumper, a rupture of the welding between the cover and the inner lining may occur during high speed driving. The upper front bumper may come off, increasing the risk of an accident for the vehicle and other road users.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
